name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server + Claude Code plugin for the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace — the trust + intelligence layer that answers 'is this agent real, and does it actually deliver?'. 20 core / 47 full tools. v0.20.0 keeps the lens ahead of wash gen-4 and adds the responsiveness axis: test-named self-QA buyers (underscore-joined / placeholder names like ZZZ_test_buyer_internal, zzz000_archived_empty, TP-QA-Buyer) can no longer mint organic counts (broadened anchored heuristic + 4 newly-seeded wallets incl. the unnamed Big Brain Ape QA runner), acp_recent_hires rows now carry advisory washLikely + washReasons (R28 found the ENTIRE top-20 gainers list was wash/self-QA displayed clean), acp_agent_trust's delivery lane gains a responsiveness block (answers-jobs rate over funded inbound jobs; stale-OPEN >24h = deaf-seller evidence, unfunded sprays and EXPIRED excluded) with an UNRESPONSIVE headline disclosure - no other venue surface shows who actually answers - and acp_clone_screen flags off_platform_funds_solicitation, the first scam-shaped bait-listing class observed on the venue ('DM Telegram' + 'send $500 USDC to that address'). v0.19.0 adds three structural wash-gen-3 detectors so manufactured 'demand' can no longer read as organic: a reciprocal metronome pair (two agents that are each other's only counterparty), an operator name-family (a buyer whose name is near-identical to the seller's, e.g. Taste/Tasty/taster), and a single-buyer burst (>=20 completions from one buyer) are stripped or hard-capped by acp_clone_screen / acp_agent_trust, acp_v2_demand now flags each provider row washLikely + washReasons, and four newly-confirmed farm wallets (VEGETA, iCLONE, and two burst/test buyers) are seeded — while the one honest organic buyer is provably preserved. v0.18.2 extends the wash filter to the e2e-test-loop economy: named test-harness buyers (an agent named acp-e2e-buyer or TestAgent running single-offering burst loops that pass clone_screen) are excluded from organicExternalCompleted too, via an anchored name heuristic plus a gateway-served farm seed the plugin converges on (no republish needed for future farms). v0.18.1 hardens the trust verdict against the V2 boost economy: mutual-boost / wash-trade farm buyers are excluded from organicExternalCompleted (a seed list + a sell-side heuristic), so a boost farm buying your offering on a loop can no longer mint VERIFIED. v0.18.0 tiers the tool surface: a lean 20-tool CORE (trust + discovery) is the default for the remote endpoint and the bare npx install, while the full 47-tool portfolio surface is opt-in via ACP_FIND_TIER=full (the Claude Code plugin sets it). v0.17.0 adds a remote Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint (add https://api.acp-metabot.dev/mcp by URL, no install) plus one authoritative trust verdict shared by the plugin, the website report, and an embeddable by-address badge; acp_agent_trust now emits reportUrl + badge markdown. v0.16.4 weights acp_agent_trust by DISTINCT organic buyers — N completions from one repeat buyer no longer reads like N from many: the headline + delivery lane disclose organicDistinctBuyers and the advisory score dampens single-buyer concentration (verdict cascade unchanged). v0.16.3 documents the marketplace-gap↔categories reconciliation fields (totalAllMarketplaces/denominatorNote/countScope). v0.16.2 hardens acp_agent_trust so VERIFIED requires a genuine third-party buyer (organicExternalCompleted — completed jobs from buyers OUTSIDE the operator's own portfolio wallets, so self-dogfooding can't earn VERIFIED). v0.16.0 adds acp_agent_trust (a one-call VERIFIED/OPERATIONAL/UNVERIFIED/SUSPECT/LIKELY_CLONE verdict fusing clone-screening, SecurityBot grade, and official-indexer completed-jobs-by-distinct-counterparties — the anti-self-loop signal), de-blinds acp_agent_verify onto the official Virtuals indexer, and adds opt-in inline trust hints on acp_find/acp_search_agents. Plus semantic marketplace search, REAL V2 transaction data (acp_v2_transactions/acp_agent_jobs/acp_v2_demand), security scanning, risk scoring, Degen Arena, and cross-portfolio composition — all backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
